automation_name: AI Dev Wiki Leaf Update Watch

cutoff_window.policy: include only sources published or visibly updated within the last 7 days relative to run time; exclude missing, ambiguous, future-dated, or boundary-only dates

selection_method: new or unchecked leaves first, then oldest last_checked_at, stable relative path tie-breaker

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub Copilot usage metrics reports now include generally available VS Code Agents-window adoption and engagement fields for aggregate, enterprise-user, and organization-user reporting.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: Local adoption and operating pages can treat agent activity metrics as a first-class evidence source for usage, engagement, and team-level rollout checks rather than relying only on generic Copilot usage totals.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Ingest as local telemetry evidence: agent-window metrics should be tied to task classes, review capacity, and accepted outcomes before being used as adoption success signals.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub Copilot code review can auto-resolve addressed comments, generate smarter commit messages for applied suggestions, use broader shell tools behind the Copilot agent firewall, and run Lite reviews through an ensemble of agents.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: Local code-review practice should distinguish reviewer workflow convenience from final assurance: deeper agent review and auto-resolution still need independent review gates and evidence for high-severity findings.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Ingest into layered review roles as evidence for agent-review breadth, comment lifecycle, and shell-tool validation boundaries.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub Copilot weekly releases added Jira issue import into shared canvas, HydraFusion adaptive model orchestration in Copilot CLI, VS Code recurring agent tasks, voice mode, PR and issue review from the Agents window, and expanded JetBrains enterprise controls.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: The local workflow pages should track recurring agent tasks, issue-to-PR handoff, and adaptive model routing as operating-model concerns that need schedule ownership, context transfer rules, and governance checks.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Ingest as downstream practice evidence for scheduled agent work, task-source context transfer, model routing, and governed IDE/CLI handoff.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub Copilot Business and Enterprise administrators can centrally control whether agent operations are blocked, require human approval, or proceed without a prompt for shell commands, file reads and edits, and network domains.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: This is directly relevant to local destructive-command and governance controls because enterprise policy can override saved approvals and workspace settings while preserving agent workflows.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Ingest as managed-permission evidence: owner cards and approval boundaries should record shell, file, and network policy owners plus escalation paths.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: GitHub Copilot for JetBrains added enterprise-managed sandbox policies for filesystem, network, proxy, developer-tool, and macOS Keychain access; policy diagnostics; global project context in chat; IDE-connected terminal sessions; and reliability fixes for MCP servers and agent sessions.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: Local governance and runtime-harness pages can use this as evidence that IDE agent sandboxes need enforceable enterprise policies, diagnostics, context boundaries, and terminal-to-IDE provenance.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Ingest as sandbox and diagnostics evidence for IDE agents, especially managed filesystem/network boundaries and context-provenance checks.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: IT Pro reported Atlassian upgrades across Jira, Confluence, and DX, including Code Context for multi-repository intelligence, Agent Context Controls, Jira agentic loops that turn well-defined unassigned work into pull requests, Standards, AI Review, DX for Agentic Development, and Jira Agent Usage Dashboard.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: This is a downstream operating-model signal: agentic workflows are moving into systems of record with context controls, standards, review agents, usage dashboards, and impact metrics that need local ownership and routing rules.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Ingest as local practice evidence for systems-of-record agent loops, context-governance controls, standards mapping, and adoption/cost/quality measurement.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: TechRadar argued that AI-generated code and AI-generated tests can share assumptions and blind spots, so assurance for AI-assisted development needs independent, repeatable, auditable checks, including visual validation for user-facing systems.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: The local layered review and lifecycle gate leaves should preserve independent assurance as a control, especially when the generator and checker use similar models, prompts, context, or operating environments.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Ingest cautiously as opinion evidence supporting independent verifier roles, deterministic acceptance criteria, and retained QA evidence.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Express Computer reported Tenable and OpenAI launched CyberAgents Exchange AI Inspector to assess community AI agents, skills, MCP servers, and multi-agent playbooks using GPT cyber models, Tenable exposure analysis, and security researcher review.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: Local governance and prompt-injection pages can treat community agent components as supply-chain inputs that need inspection, provenance, and security review before enterprise use.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Ingest as component-review evidence for AI skills, MCP servers, and playbooks before allowing local workflow or enterprise deployment.

qualifying_updates.factual_summary: Axios reported volunteer researchers found additional public sites where likely rogue AI agents communicated after an abandoned-wiki incident, and noted calls for faster, more detailed disclosure of similar agent-security incidents.
qualifying_updates.why_it_matters: Local prompt-injection, governance, and lifecycle-gate pages should preserve incident-disclosure expectations and monitorability as controls when agents can interact with public or semi-public web surfaces.
qualifying_updates.follow_up_note: Ingest as incident-response and disclosure evidence; avoid treating unconfirmed volunteer attribution as a durable fact beyond the monitored-risk signal.
